# 2 Chronicles Chapter 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-sent Hezekiah to all Israel and-Judah and-also letters he-wrote to Ephraim and-Manasseh to-come to-house-of YHWH in-Jerusalem to-make Passover to-YHWH God-of Israel.

**2** And-he-counseled the-king and-his-princes and-all the-assembly in-Jerusalem to-make the-Passover in-the-month the-second.

**3** For not they-could to-make-it at-its-time for the-priests not had-consecrated-themselves for-sufficiency and-the-people not had-gathered to-Jerusalem.

**4** And-the-thing was-right in-eyes-of the-king and-in-eyes-of all the-assembly.

**5** And-they-established a-decree to-cause-to-pass a-voice in-all Israel from-Beer-sheba and-to Dan to-come to-make Passover to-YHWH God-of Israel in-Jerusalem for not for-abundance they-had-made as-written.

**6** And-they-went the-runners with-letters from-hand-of the-king and-his-princes in-all Israel and-Judah and-according-to-commandment-of the-king saying sons-of Israel return to-YHWH God-of Abraham Isaac and-Israel and-He-will-return to the-remnant the-escaped to-you from-hand-of kings-of Assyria.

**7** And-do-not be like-your-fathers and-like-your-brothers who were-unfaithful against-YHWH God-of their-fathers and-He-gave-them for-desolation as-you are-seeing.

**8** Now do-not stiffen your-neck like-your-fathers give hand to-YHWH and-come to-His-sanctuary that He-consecrated forever and-serve YHWH your-God and-He-will-turn from-you burning-of His-anger.

**9** For in-your-returning to YHWH your-brothers and-your-sons will-find compassion before their-captors and-to-return to this land for gracious and-compassionate is-YHWH your-God and-not He-will-turn face from-you if you-return to-Him.

**10** And-they-were the-runners passing from-city to-city in-land-of Ephraim and-Manasseh and-to Zebulun and-they-were laughing at-them and-mocking them.

**11** Only men from-Asher and-Manasseh and-from-Zebulun humbled-themselves and-they-came to-Jerusalem.

**12** Also in-Judah was hand-of God to-give to-them heart one to-do commandment-of the-king and-the-princes in-word-of YHWH.

**13** And-they-gathered to-Jerusalem people much to-make feast-of the-unleavened-bread in-the-month the-second assembly great very.

**14** And-they-arose and-they-removed the-altars that were-in Jerusalem and-all the-incense-altars they-removed and-they-threw to-brook Kidron.

**15** And-they-slaughtered the-Passover on-fourteen of-the-month the-second and-the-priests and-the-Levites were-ashamed and-they-consecrated-themselves and-they-brought burnt-offerings to-house-of YHWH.

**16** And-they-stood on their-station according-to-their-rule according-to-law-of Moses man-of God the-priests were-dashing the-blood from-hand-of the-Levites.

**17** For many in-the-assembly who not had-consecrated-themselves and-the-Levites were-over slaughtering-of the-Passovers for-every-one not clean to-consecrate to-YHWH.

**18** For a-multitude-of the-people many from-Ephraim and-Manasseh Issachar and-Zebulun not had-purified-themselves for they-ate the-Passover not as-written for prayed Hezekiah for-them saying YHWH the-good may-He-atone for

**19** every-one who-set his-heart to-seek God YHWH God-of his-fathers and-not according-to-purification-of the-sanctuary.

**20** And-He-heard YHWH to Hezekiah and-He-healed the-people.

**21** And-they-made sons-of Israel the-found in-Jerusalem feast-of the-unleavened-bread seven days in-joy great and-praising to-YHWH day by-day the-Levites and-the-priests with-instruments-of strength to-YHWH.

**22** And-he-spoke Hezekiah to heart-of all the-Levites the-insightful with-good insight to-YHWH and-they-ate the-appointed-feast the-seven days sacrificing sacrifices-of peace-offerings and-giving-thanks to-YHWH God-of their-fathers.

**23** And-they-counseled all the-assembly to-make seven days other and-they-made seven days of-joy.

**24** For Hezekiah king-of Judah contributed to-the-assembly bulls a-thousand and-sheep seven-thousand and-the-princes contributed to-the-assembly bulls a-thousand and-sheep ten-thousand and-they-consecrated-themselves priests for-abundance.

**25** And-they-rejoiced all assembly-of Judah and-the-priests and-the-Levites and-all the-assembly the-coming from-Israel and-the-sojourners the-coming from-land-of Israel and-the-dwelling in-Judah.

**26** And-there-was joy great in-Jerusalem for from-days-of Solomon son-of David king-of Israel not was-like-this in-Jerusalem.

**27** And-they-arose the-priests the-Levites and-they-blessed the-people and-He-heard to-their-voice and-it-came their-prayer to-dwelling-of His-holiness to-the-heavens.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **30:1**: to all Israel and-Judah — Hezekiah's Passover invitation crosses political boundaries, reaching into the former northern kingdom. This is a reunification effort through worship.

- **30:9**: gracious and-compassionate is-YHWH — The classic divine self-description (Exodus 34:6) applied to the invitation: return is always possible because God is always willing to receive.

- **30:18-20**: not according-to-purification...He-healed — God accepts impure worshipers whose hearts are sincere. Ritual purity is subordinated to the intention of the heart. This is a radical theological statement.

- **30:26**: from-days-of Solomon — The Chronicler's highest compliment: Hezekiah's Passover rivals Solomon's temple dedication. The circle of restoration is complete.


— EMET
